 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Mirra Andreeva has had an  impressive run in what is her debut in the tournament having secured straight-sets wins over Elina Svitolina and Aryna Sabalenka, booking.
 Her 6-4, 6-0 victory over Sabalenka ensured she finished as the Group 2 winner, regardless of the result against Muchova.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Russian has thus already secured her place in the 2026 WTA Finals semifinals, but she still has one round-robin match remaining against Karolina Muchova today.
 Muchova, meanwhile, lost both her matches and is eliminated from semifinal contention. 
 Aug 29, 2025; Flushing, NY, USA; Mirra Andreeva of Russia in action against Taylor Townsend of the United States in the third round of the women's singles at the US Open at Arthur Ashe Stadium in Billie Jean King National Tennis Center. Mandatory Credit: Mike Frey-Imagn ImagesMike Frey-Imagn Images
 She will be looking to end her campaign with a victory after defeats against Sabalenka and Svitolina.
 What Happens If Mirra Andreeva Wins Against Karolina Muchova?
 If Andreeva defeats Muchova, she will complete the group stage with a perfect 3-0 record without changing anything else.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement NEW YORK, NEW YORK – SEPTEMBER 09: Mirra Andreeva looks on against Coco Gauff of the United States during their Women's Singles Quarterfinal match on Day Eleven of the 2026 US Open at USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center on September 09, 2026 in the Flushing neighborhood of the Queens borough of New York City. (Photo by Sarah Stier/Getty Images)Sarah Stier/Getty Images
 The teenager has yet to drop a set in the tournament and will be looking to maintain that record.
 What Happens If Mirra Andreeva Loses Against Karolina Muchova?
 Even if the 19-year-old loses to Muchova, she will still advance to the semifinals as the Group 2 winner. Her victories over Sabalenka and Svitolina have already ensured that the top spot belongs to her. 
 A defeat would leave Andreeva with a 2-1 record, but neither Sabalenka nor Svitolina can overtake her. Both players are currently 1-1 and will face each other in the final Group 2 match, meaning only one can finish with two victories.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Muchova, meanwhile, will finish the tournament with a 1-2 record if she defeats Andreeva.
